# Restored Rubies                                                                     

This mod for NeoForge adds Rubies from prealpha back into Minecraft as standalone resources. These rubies have late game benefits, such as high attack power and built in efficiency.                                                                                  

# Mobs
                                                                                                 
This project adds exactly one mob to the game, which is the Ruby Zombie. Grotesque, twisted crystal monstrosities, they will relentlessly try to kill you if you find yourself near a ruby vein in a Stony Peaks. Upon death, they drop the Ruby Portal Igniter, an essential tool for progression, because it lights the Ruby Portal.                
                                                                                        
# Items


<details>
<summary>Spoiler: Items</summary>
Rubies, the fundamental item. Ruby Swords, Ruby Pickaxes, and Ruby Battleaxe. Also ruby armor. Ruby armor has missing texture on leggings. Also an item, is the bucket of ruby pool. Ruby pools generate in the Ruby Dimension. The Ruby Flower is a decoration. 


</details>

# Blocks

There are 4 blocks in this mod:
- Ruby block, crafted from rubies, aesthetic only
- Ruby pool, spawns instead of water in the Ruby dimension
- Ruby Portal, nether portal equivalent for the Ruby portal
- Ruby Flower, a decorative (but slightly ugly) flower.
